Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Warranty Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period: After having been notified of the defects / service requirement during warranty period, Seller has to complete the required Service / Rectification within 15 days time limit. If the Seller fails to complete service / rectification with defined time limit, a penalty of 0.5% of Unit Price of the product shall be charged as penalty for each week of delay from the seller. Seller can deposit the penalty with the Buyer directly else the Buyer shall have a right to recover all such penalty amount from the Performance Security (PBG).Cumulative Penalty cannot exceed more than 10% of the total contract value after which the Buyer shall have the right to get the service / rectification done from alternate sources at the risk and cost of the Seller besides forfeiture of PBG. Seller shall be liable to re-imberse the cost of such service / rectification to the Buyer. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS Following additional Terms & Conditions on the subject Bid for procureme nt of High End Utility Vehicle (4x4) more than 200 BHP is mentioned: PQ CRITERIA/OTHER TERMS & CONDITIONS. 1. Performance Evaluation of Offered Vehicle. (a) If the offered vehicle is not trial evaluated in BRO . The bidder m

ust be an OEM and must have sold in market a minimum 6 Nos of vehicle of similar or higher capacity in last three years, ending on 31st March of th e previous financial year. Copies of related Supply Orders and Performanc e certificates, in support of these will be submitted by the bidder. BRO res erves the right to conduct limited ‘No Cost No Commitment’ basis perform ance trials for a period of 50 hrs running at a mutually agreed project loca tion including Vendor Premises. OR (b) If the offered vehicle is trial evaluated in BRO and is not in service in BRO / Indian Army. The offered vehicle has been trial evalua ted and found successful in BRO/ has been found qualified in staff evaluati on for procurement by Indian Army. Documentary proof in support of this be enclosed. OR (c) If the offered vehicle is in service in BRO. The offered vehicle is p resently in service with BRO and its Performance is Satisfactory. Performa nce of vehicle already inducted in BRO shall be evaluated internally by E4 (Repair)/TA Dte/HQ DGBR. In case found unsatisfactory, the bid of concern ed bidder shall be rejected. In this regard the decision of BRO is final. 2. Experience Criteria : The Bidder i.e. OEM (themselves or through reselle rs(s)) should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar C ategory Products for 3 years before the bid opening date. Copies of relev ant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied a definite quantity during each of the year. 3. Warranty. (i) The SELLER warrants that the goods supplied under this contract conform to technical speci fications prescribed and shall perform according to the said Technical Specifications. (ii) The SELLER warrants for a period of minimum 3 years or 100000 kms, whichever is earlier fr om the date of supply of Goods that the goods/stores supplied under this contract and each compo nent used in the manufacture thereof shall be free from all types of defects/failures. 4. Resources for providing Spares & Consumables for maintenance up to 10 yrs. The bidder sh ould have adequate facilities pan India to carry out after sales service at various consignees for a tot al period of 10 (Ten) years including Guarantee/Warranty period of 03 (Three) year and 07 (Seven) y ears thereafter in terms of supply of spares. 5. Price to be quoted shall inclusive of GST and freight charges. 6. This bid is reserved for OEMs only.

7. Diagnostic Tool Kit: 10 Nos vehicle Diagnostic Tool Kit (01 No. for each consignee), including 02 Nos for 532 SS &TC, Siliguri (01 No. each for (P) Swastik and 01 for (P) Dantak) shall be provided by the successful bidder f or effective field repair. The Vehicle Diagnostic Kit shall comprise of latest OBD Hardware Interface /Scan Tool, a fully compatible laptop with latest c onfiguration and all required software licenses and diagnostic cables. 8. A Sticker shall be affixed on both sides of the vehicle as per the design iss ued by BRO. 9. Engineering Support Package. (i) Tools. One set of tools required for undertaking regular and period ical maintenance, shall be provided along with the each vehicle, on F REE OF COST. (ii) MRLS. Three Set of hard copy of documents containing Manufactu rer Recommended List of Spares (MRLS) covering both repair & maint enance spares for periodical maintenance of vehicle and one set doc ument containing list of overhaul spares required for 100 vehicles sha ll be provided at the time of PDI. (iii) Technical Literature: All Technical Literatures (hard copy in Englis h) described below shall be supplied by the Seller on FREE OF COST al ong with each vehicles:- (aa) Running, Repair and maintenance manual for both engine a nd vehicle. (ab) Workshop manual for both engine and vehicle. (ac) Illustrated parts catalogue for both engine and vehicle. (ad) Illustrated list of Special Maintenance Tools, if any. (ae) Lubrication charts for complete vehicle. (af) In addition, following literature to be handed over to HQ DG BR/E4 Tech :- (i) Illustrated parts catalogue of engine and vehicle- 05 Sets. (ii) Running, Repair and Maint manual for both engine and v ehicle- 03 Sets. (iii) Lubrication charts for complete vehicle- 03 Sets. (iv) Workshop manual for both engine and vehicle- 02 Sets. (v) Soft copy of all above literature at S/No. (i) to (iv)- 01 Set.
